name: Ordinary Mind Zen Melbourne
reason: Thin, no place photo: a small sitting group that meets once a month (third Sunday) in a hall at Kangaroo Ground, with three zazenkai days a year and no own premises; its only images are a logo, a coastal landscape (Flinders) and book covers; no email (contact form only), and its talks are its Sydney-based teacher Geoff Dawson's on SoundCloud. Only about 3 possible items (monthly meeting, zazenkai, starting-out guide). Revisit as a teacher listing for Geoff Dawson (Ordinary Mind Zen School, Sydney) rather than as a centre.
